4681-5170-5686-8292.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

4681-5147-5170-8292.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

2645-3230-3430-4644.easyPrerequisites: Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3230-3430-4644.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2023-4770-6006-6968.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-4452-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2034-4452-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

3284-3899-4550-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3284-3899-4550-4871.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

215-1376-4885.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-1376-4885.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5147-5542-6153.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6153.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Vicious Battlerager from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Vicious Battlerager.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Vicious Battlerager token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Vicious Battlerager trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6153.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

550-1636-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
550-1636-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Young Pyromancer triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

851-4365-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

2292-3249-5173-5334.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

2440-2703-4478.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

4682-5184-7132.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more than once.
4682-5184-7132.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, causing an opponent to draw four cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers four times, causing you to create two Treasure tokens for each time the opponent cannot pay for the trigger.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}.
Repeat.
4682-5184-7132.notes:
If the opponent can pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more times, you can still perform the combo if you have enough mana to outlast their mana supply. You can also continue this combo for other opponents if mana allows.
The extra mana can be used to activate any of Super-Skrull's abilities.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-6774-7329.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Mind Transfer Protocol
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

3259-4927-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
3259-4927-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

628-2921-7211.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Brambleback Brute.
When Brambleback Brute dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2760-2850-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Ivy Lane Denizen triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Devoted Druid.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4210-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4210-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Pious Evangel or Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain life and target opponent to lose 1 life if Wayward Disciple triggered.
Repeat from step 2.

4924-6869-6884.description:
Cast Aang, Airbending Master by paying {2}{W}
When Aang, Airbending Master enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, the Last Airbender
Cast Aang, the Last Airbender from exile by paying {0}.
When Aang, the Last Airbender enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, Airbending Master.
Cast Aang, Airbending Master from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

2018-4053-6297.description:
Activate King Darien XLVIII by sacrificing it.
When King Darien XLVIII dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning King Darien XLVIII from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the King Darien XLVIII ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three lore counters on it

112-3263-6573-6577.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone three or more times this game.
112-3263-6573-6577.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Summon: Esper Valigarmanda triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its fourth chapter ability.
Holding priority, cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, removing a lore counter from Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Resolve the Summon: Esper Valigarmanda ability, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, putting a lore counter on Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Summon: Esper Valigarmanda's fourth chapter ability triggers.
Repeat from step 2.

428-1694-1844-5361.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
You have enough mana to cast Fateful Handoff.
428-1694-1844-5361.description:
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Auton Soldier triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

1902-3812-5963.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1902-3812-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Wirewood Channeler's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1858-1879-2056.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-1858-1879-2056.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

372-1917-1938.manaNeeded: {2}{W}, plus an additional {W} if Glorious Protector was not foretold
372-1917-1938.description:
Cast Glorious Protector by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Glorious Protector enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Touch the Spirit Realm to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Touch the Spirit Realm enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Glorious Protector until Touch the Spirit Realm leaves the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Touch the Spirit Realm and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Touch the Spirit Realm leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Glorious Protector to return to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

1242-1563-2144.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat step 1 until Cinderhaze Wretch dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Myrkul triggers, causing you to exile Cinderhaze Wretch and create a token copy of Cinderhaze Wretch that is an enchantment and loses all other card types.
Activate the Cinderhaze Wretch token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Cinderhaze Wretch token's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 4.

163-2452-5113-5220.description:
Cast Diver Skaab either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
When Diver Skaab enters the battlefield, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Diver Skaab dies, Mortuary triggers, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

800-1812-2470-4893.description:
Activate Grand Architect's second ability by tapping Knacksaw Clique, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Prismite by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Knacksaw Clique by paying {U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponents library and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.

927-1415.notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Giant Shark.
A player controls no Islands.
927-1415.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, giving control of Giant Shark to an opponent who controls no Islands.
When Giant Shark's controller controls no Islands, Giant Shark triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Giant Shark cannot be sacrificed due to its ability.
Giant Shark triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

1048-1267-3753-4600-5241.notablePrerequisites: Gudul Lurker does not have summoning sickness.
1048-1267-3753-4600-5241.description:
Declare Gudul Lurker as an attacker.
During the declare blockers phase, when you recieve priority, activate Sakashima's Student's Ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Gudul Lurker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sakashima's Student from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai.
Deal combat damage with Sakashima's Student, causing you to take an additional turn after this one.
Cast Gudul Lurker by paying {U}.
Equilibrium triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return Sakashima's Student from the battlefield to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
